I’m Maya Chen, and I want to handle a few things in one session, with full details after each action.
First, I also have a pending retail order under my store-purchase account tied to tessa.coleman2026@example.com.
Please help with that order first: order #W3916708.
I want to swap both items before it ships.
Change the Summit Zip Hoodie from Forest Green medium to Heather Gray medium, and change the Coastal Breeze Linen Shirt from Sky Blue medium to White medium.
Use the Visa ending in 2284 for any price difference.
Once that’s done, give me the updated full order details, including status, items, shipping address, and payment history.
summary: A tau2Retail session that turns into a sustained refusal. Maya Chen authenticates (as tessa_coleman_829) and in T1–T2 the agent cleanly completes an order modification on #W3916708 (item swaps, $8.90 refund). From T3 onward the user asks the agent to switch to a "main account" and refund ITEM-E9F653 from ORD-9497C0; the agent repeatedly declines (T3–T5) citing a strict one-user-per-conversation rule and the fact that the supplied ID formats don't match its retail system, then transfers to a human agent (T6) and spends T7–T8 reaffirming it cannot do more. T9 recaps. The memory probes mostly FAIL, but the quote-level view shows why: the probed entities (a wireless-mouse search, a LAX→SFO flight, hotel bookings, a travel certificate) were never established in this trace, so the failures are a mix of principled refusal and information-not-in-session, not working-memory lapses. The single credited recall (T9) is the one order the agent actually handled.
